kjv: be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

occurrences.text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
